results.title: Troopr | LinkedIn
results.content:
Troopr AI Scrum Master is live on Product Hunt today. 🎉
It joins your team's standup call, Google Meet today, as a participant rather than a recorder, and it writes each person's update from their real Jira, GitHub, and Slack activity. Then it flags what does not add up. The ticket someone called done that is still in review. The blocker from last Tuesday that never got an owner. The PR nobody mentioned.
What makes that possible is memory. Troopr builds a model of how your team works: who owns what, what "done" means here, your cadence, your recurring risks. Notetakers start every meeting from zero, so their summaries have no way to know any of that. Troopr starts from everything it already knows about your team, and you can open that model, read it, correct it, or delete it.
